description: A ship too deep to steer

participation.context: Kept the landing, and refused the gold.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Brought the ship home at full size, from a lighter, and said it would hold fair.
participation.name: Davy Gannet

participation.context: Held the boat, and walked up without the gold.
participation.name: George Bryan

relations.note: the stairs have the news first, and largest

story.body: You let Gannet spend the second half of February's story. You asked who had been on the ship. You went on to Paul's for paper, and you left the gold on the stair.

relations.note: the stairs have the news first, and largest

title: Heard Gannet on Raleigh's gold ship

participation.context: Reported the shrink from stair to pillar, and took Navarre.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Spent the name, and was told the jig is what he is offered.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Set Navarre at two, and kept Raleigh out of the company book.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Told him the scarf comes off for the oath, and sent him to eat.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

relations.note: Navarre at two, and no ship in the book
relations.quote: Navarre at two. The book is the book.

story.body: You came in scarfed. You gave them the small tale and not the gold. You kept Navarre for two, and Kemp kept the name.

relations.note: Navarre at two, and no ship in the book
relations.quote: Navarre at two. The book is the book.

title: Arrived at the Theatre by ten in a scarf

description: Navarre, and the Rose's two bills

participation.context: Played the King of Navarre, and did not cross the water.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the title, the hour, and your side. You played. You read the Rose's two bills and stayed on this bank.

title: Played the King of Navarre
